selected_claims.text: For PMMA rods the flammability boundary has its minimum at very low airflow, on the order of diffusive flows, and the flow needed to blow the flame off becomes slower as oxygen decreases.
limitations: PMMA rods in concurrent flow; oxygen at or below cabin air.

selected_claims.text: Because microgravity smoke can stay in still air and particles grow at low flow, spacecraft smoke detectors should be designed and tested for larger particles than in flowing air.
limitations: Design implication drawn by the investigators, not a detector test result.

selected_claims.text: FLEX observed 'cool flames': low-temperature combustion processes in microgravity.
limitations: Stated in the PSI-69 summary; the detailed evidence is in the FLEX publications.
Whether burning continues after the visible flame goes out needs a FLEX publication as evidence.

selected_claims.text: A 0.1 mm PMMA film in opposed flow was extinguished in two ways: radiative quenching when the flow dropped below about 2 cm/s, and blowoff when it rose above about 40 cm/s.
limitations: Thin film in opposed flow only; thresholds read from a poster summary.

selected_claims.text: A 1/4-inch PMMA rod kept spreading steadily in microgravity at 13.6 % O2, while in normal gravity the flame blew off at 16 % O2: a negative oxygen margin of safety of 2.4 % O2. Normal-gravity flammability limits should be de-rated by at least that much.
limitations: One material and rod size, concurrent (stagnation-point) flow.
Microgravity on the ISS; no partial-gravity data.

selected_claims.text: Of 29 tests on SIBAL cotton-fiberglass fabric and a PMMA spherical section in purely forced concurrent flow, 6 ended in quenching while the flow was reduced and 1 in blowoff while it was increased.
limitations: Counts from the investigator summary; per-test outcomes are not in the PSI-25 table.

selected_claims.text: In the 17 FLEX tests at 30-34 % O2 and about 0.7 atm (close to the planned Moon-base atmosphere), 15 droplets ended in disruption and 2 burned to completion; none extinguished on its own.
limitations: Liquid fuel droplets (methanol, heptane) in quiescent microgravity, not cabin materials.
Lunar gravity is not represented; disruption is not extinguishment.

selected_claims.text: Smoke particles were larger at low flow rates.
limitations: Trend stated by the investigators; see figures on page 8.
